full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Implementing the MDTM algorithm with collapsed Gibbs sampling
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: Implement the Online MDTM model from the KDD 2010 paper, including multiscale word distributions, collapsed Gibbs sampling, and stochastic EM, with code-to-paper annotations.
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: The agent implemented the full OnlineMDTM class with: _compute_dirichlet_prior (Eq. 1-3), _gibbs_sampling (Eq. 7-8), _update_alpha (Eq. 9-10), _update_lambda (Eq. 11), _update_multiscale_dists (Eq. 5-6), and _compute_perplexity (Eq. 12).
full_llm_interaction_log.student_modification: I verified each method against the corresponding paper equations, adjusted the P_scale parameter for numerical stability, and added the LDA baseline implementation for comparison. I also added detailed markdown annotations explaining each code block's correspondence to paper sections.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: I checked each equation reference against the paper and verified the Gibbs sampling conditional probability formula matches Eq. 7-8.

full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: Also implement a standard LDA baseline that runs independently per epoch for comparison.
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Agent implemented StandardLDA class with the same Gibbs sampling approach but flat Dirichlet prior and no temporal linkage.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_modification: Reviewed and confirmed the LDA implementation uses the same evaluation metric (perplexity) for fair comparison.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Verified the LDA implementation is a correct simplification of the MDTM by removing temporal components.
